name: Simulación de Poros de Piel
description: Analiza la simulación de poros de piel para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Skin Pore Simulation — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes skin pore similarity patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Pore Patrón Extracción**: Skin pore patterns are extracted from high-resolution facial regions using local morphological operators. Pore centers are localized and characterized by size, depth (estimated from shadow), and spacing.

2. **Intra - Frame Pore Consistencia**: Within each frame, pore characteristics should vary systematically across the face (larger on nose, medium on cheeks, smaller on forehead). The method checks for anatomically correct pore distribution. AI generators may produce spatially uniform pore patterns or incorrect regional variation.

3. **Inter - Frame Pore Estabilidad**: Pore patterns should remain identical across frames (pores are fixed skin structures). The method computes pore pattern similarity between frames using point matching. High inter-frame pore pattern variation indicates AI generation where pore texture is generated independently per frame.

4. **Pore Resolución Evaluación**: Pore visibility depends on resolution and should be consistent across the face at the same camera distance. The method checks whether pore resolution matches the video's spatial resolution. AI-generated faces may show resolution-inconsistent pore rendering — visible pores in some regions but smooth skin in others at the same scale.

5. **Synthetic Pore Patrón Detección**: AI-generated pore patterns may show statistical regularities absent in natural skin: (a) too-perfect hexagonal spacing (crystalline pattern), (b) exact repetition of pore patches (texture tiling), (c) pore patterns that don't respond to skin stretching during expression. These markers are quantified for scoring.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante skin pore simulation analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
